description: A trigger sequencer on a grid five across and sixteen down: each row of five squares is one step, and each of the five columns has its own trigger output

params.text: Freezes the grid for editing; with it off the pattern scrolls through the grid as the sequence runs
Switches its square on or off; a lit square fires its column's output when the sequence reaches its step

inputs.text: A rise here sets the sequence back to the first step
A rise here moves the sequence on by one step, firing the output of every lit square in that step

outputs.text: A 10V pulse lasting fifty samples when the sequence reaches a step with this column's square lit

notes: there is no clock in this module: the sequence moves one step each time a trigger arrives at the STEP input, so a clock has to be patched there

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
